title: Type Hierarchy
slide_intent: Teach designers to size text roles in relation to a headline so readers can distinguish an invitation, supporting detail and legal copy.
strategic_value: A proportional hierarchy can preserve Instacart’s emphasis as layouts change size, while a minimum legal size protects the smallest information.
demonstration: A role specimen labels the eyebrow as one-sixth of headline size and the subheadline as one-third. Arrows connect the sample to tracking and leading notes still marked TBD.
practical_value: Set the headline first, calculate the supporting roles, then check the 8 pt minimum for legal copy. Treat the unresolved tracking and leading entries as draft values.

content_islands.name: Usage rules
content_islands.spec: Stack case, justification, proportions and tracking guidance in a narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Role specimen
content_islands.spec: Compose an eyebrow, display headline, subheadline, body and legal copy in a central stack. Keep the relative size relationships visible.

content_islands.name: Settings key
content_islands.spec: Run arrows to a right-hand column of role names and status notes; preserve the TBD labels for unresolved settings.
